# Rule 3.5 Full continuity of your character and the events that happen to them is recommended, but not required. All rounds and the events that happened within them are considered canon unless otherwise stated by an admin. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• You are allowed to recall past shifts in any manner unless it violates the [textlink="New Life Rule." link="Rule3.4"] 

• Permanent death is not required and is completely up to the player. Clone backups are created and stored at an off-site facility for the majority of the crew; however, a character may choose not to consent to this for any reason.
